strings.wizard.step.CheckDevice.title: 1. Check Device
strings.wizard.step.CheckDevice.description: Plug the device into the computer with a USB cable and make sure USB debugging is on.
strings.wizard.step.UnlockBootloader.title: 2. Unlock Bootloader
strings.wizard.step.UnlockBootloader.description: Unlocking the bootloader is required before any partition can be written. All data on the device will be erased.
strings.wizard.step.FlashRecovery.title: 3. Flash Recovery
strings.wizard.step.FlashRecovery.description: Pick the recovery file (.img) and flash it to the recovery partition.
strings.wizard.step.WipeData.title: 4. Wipe Data
strings.wizard.step.WipeData.description: Erase user data so the install is completely clean. All data on the device will be erased.
strings.wizard.step.RebootToRecovery.title: 5. Reboot to Recovery
strings.wizard.step.RebootToRecovery.description: Restart the device into Recovery mode so the ROM file can be sideloaded.
strings.wizard.step.SideloadRom.title: 6. Sideload ROM
strings.wizard.step.SideloadRom.description: Pick the ROM file (.zip) and sideload it to the device.
strings.wizard.step.RebootToSystem.title: 7. Reboot to Android
strings.wizard.step.RebootToSystem.description: Restart the device into Android. The ROM install is done once the device boots normally.
